title: Applying an industry template only adds pipelines; wording and accreditation are an administrator's

steps.do: As Test Director: Left menu → Admin → Settings → Your industry → pick "Manufacturing & engineering".
steps.expect: Only "Add these pipelines" is offered; no "Make this our company's industry" panel.
steps.observed: The panel is right (only "Add these pipelines"), but the Director cannot get there by Left menu → Admin → Settings → Your industry: Admin has no Settings tile for the Director, and /settings says "Only admins can change settings." — only by typing /industry.

steps.expect: Message "… pipelines added. 3 pipelines created … Your wording and accreditation rules are unchanged." The inspection words and ISO/IEC 17020 rules are still in place.
steps.observed: "Manufacturing & engineering pipelines added. 3 pipelines created — a main funnel (now the default), an alternate funnel and a lead pipeline, with 17 list values…" Pipelines 5 → 8; wording pack still "inspection", accreditation rules still "inspection" (ISO/IEC 17020).
steps.note: Side effect: "Add these pipelines" also switched the company's default unit for a new quotation line from Man-day to "NOS" (setting default_charge_unit) — an inspection company now starts every new line in Nos although its wording is "unchanged".

steps.expect: A separate panel "Make this our company's industry" lists each change, e.g. "The inspection (ISO/IEC 17020) accreditation rules will be turned OFF." and a tick-box "I understand the changes listed above."
steps.observed: Separate panel: "Make this our company's industry This sets the words everyone in the company sees and which accreditation rules run. It creates no pipeline. The wording everyone sees changes to "Manufacturing & fabrication" (now "Inspection & certification"). The inspection (ISO/IEC 17020) accreditation rules will be turned OFF. I understand th"

steps.expect: Refused: "Tick the confirmation first — it lists what will change."
steps.observed: Refused, but with "Nothing has been saved — I understand the changes listed above. needs ticking." — not "Tick the confirmation first — it lists what will change."

steps.expect: Wording changes; accreditation off; no pipeline created by this step.
steps.observed: "Your company's industry is now Manufacturing & engineering. No accreditation rules are on." — wording pack now "manufacturing" (e.g. Production Order / Production Orders), accreditation rules off, pipelines still 8.

"Your company's industry is now Inspection, testing & certification. The inspection (ISO/IEC 17020) accreditation rules are ON." — wording "inspection", accreditation rules "inspection" (ISO/IEC 17020) back on.
